attempts.errorSummary: All 8 E2E test failures are test-code defects in e2e/plp-quick-view.spec.ts, not implementation bugs. The feature code is correct (verified manually). Three distinct test bugs: (1) BASELINE_NOISE_PATTERNS regex has typo - missing space in "release\.Use" should be "release\. Use" (affects 5 tests), (2) variant swatch selector uses 'button[aria-label*="size"]' but swatches are <a> elements inside [role="radiogroup"] (affects add-to-bag test), (3) tile-click test looks for <a> inside sf-product-tile-* but that element IS the <a> (timeout).

All 8 E2E test failures are test-code defects in e2e/plp-quick-view.spec.ts — no implementation code changes needed. Three bugs: (1) BASELINE_NOISE_PATTERNS[1] regex has 'release\.Use' but actual message has 'release. Use' (missing space) — causes 7/8 tests to fail console-error budget assertion; (2) E2E-003 size swatch selector uses 'button[aria-label*="size" i]' but PWA Kit renders swatches as <a> elements inside [role="radiogroup"][aria-label="Size"]; (3) E2E-008 does tile.locator('a').first() but data-testid="sf-product-tile-*" IS the <a> element itself (Link component), so descendant search finds nothing and times out.

All 8 E2E test failures are test-code defects in e2e/plp-quick-view.spec.ts. The implementation code (modal-body.jsx, context.jsx, trigger.jsx, etc.) is correct — it follows the identical pattern as the PDP's handleAddToCart. Three bugs in the test file need fixing by e2e-author:

1. BASELINE_NOISE_PATTERNS[1] (line ~29): regex has 'release\.Use' but actual console message has 'release. Use' (missing space in regex). This causes 6-7 tests to fail the console-error budget assertion. Fix: change to 'release\.\s*Use' or 'release\. Use'.

2. E2E-003 size swatch selector (line ~213): uses 'button[aria-label*="size" i]' but PWA Kit renders swatches as <a> elements inside [role="radiogroup"]. The wrong selector means size isn't selected, leading to API failure and modal staying open. Fix: use 'a[aria-label*="size" i]' or target the radiogroup properly.

3. E2E-008 tile click (line ~379-380): does tile.locator('a').first() but data-testid="sf-product-tile-*" IS the <a> element itself (Link component), so descendant 'a' search finds nothing and times out. Fix: click the tile element directly.
